forecast_notes: Dates are planning windows, not release commitments or assigned future versions.
Six releases on two days are a short burst, including prepared work and a hotfix; do not extrapolate a linear release rate.
Assume steady owner/Codex work with review, Windows validation, fixes and usage-limit pauses.
Online services and mobile have wider uncertainty and require verified access and owner decisions before costs.
Review after each major milestone and preserve detailed phase completion gates.
